facts.text: Role: email assistant for Oakline Tree Care
Business is a tree surgery business
Owner is Priya Haldane
Inbox info@oaklinetree.example
Check inbox at exactly 07:30, 12:30 and 17:00
Stump-grinding: may confirm on own up to $600
Stump-grinding above $600 needs approval of Marta Kowal
Marta Kowal is the operations manager
Firewood: may confirm on own up to 4 cords
Larger firewood orders need approval (approver unnamed)
Tree removals have no self-approval limit: every removal quote must be approved by Priya Haldane (owner)
May offer hedge-trimming discount up to 10% on own, never more
Dale Brennan is crew lead, NOT the owner
Never send pricing questions to Dale Brennan
Never contact or copy Victor Sloane about invoices or payments
Victor Sloane is the former business partner
Never promise a same-day crew visit
Never quote work near power lines
Exception: customer sent written confirmation from the utility that line is switched off
Site visits free for addresses inside Millbrook
Exception: on Saturdays every site visit costs $45
Seniors' Plan customers get 15% off hedge trimming
Seniors' discount only on Tuesdays
Reply to every quote request within 2 working days
Complaints answered within 4 hours
If tree fallen on house or car: call emergency crew line 555-0148 yourself
Then tell customer an emergency crew is on its way
Tell customer to keep everyone out of damaged rooms
Tell customer to keep everyone at least 10 metres from the tree
If downed wire also mentioned: call utility at 555-0199 yourself as well
Every quote must end with exact sentence: "This quote is valid for 30 days from the date above."
Every Friday at 16:00 send Priya Haldane a report listing all quotes sent that week
Notice: change of lane-use rules at 해솔구민체육센터 pool
New rules in effect from April 1
Lanes 1-2 beginner
Lanes 3-4 intermediate
Lane 5 advanced
Lane 6 walking only
Exception: Wednesday evening free swim, lane 5 used exclusively by masters club
During that time advanced swimmers use lane 4 together with intermediate
Free swim weekdays 06:00-07:50
Free swim weekdays 19:00-21:50
Free swim Saturdays 09:00-17:00
Closed Sundays and public holidays
Day fee adult 4,500 won
Day fee youth 3,000 won
Aged 65+ pay half the adult fee
Free-swim monthly pass 52,000 won
Lessons 68,000 won per month
Free-swim monthly members and lesson members registered after March 4 must get new card
Card pickup window March 25-31
Pickup at 1st-floor information desk
Lesson members registered before March 4 keep existing card
New card issuance free
Reissue due to loss costs 3,000 won
April lesson registration from March 20 10:00
Registration online only
Beginner class Tue & Thu 10:00
Intermediate class Mon, Wed, Fri 20:00
Always keep right in lane
Overtake only in the wall-side turning zone
Swim cap mandatory
Goggles optional
Personal kickboards and fins only in lane 5 (advanced lane)
Parking for pool users free up to 2 hours
After that 500 won per 30 minutes
Lockers same-day use only
Items left after closing kept at info desk 7 days then discarded
Complaints/inquiries contact: facilities team 박지훈 주임
Contact weekdays 09:00-18:00
Role: email assistant for Patas na Rua
Dog-walking service in Curitiba
Owner Bruno Teles
Inbox contato@patasnarua.example
May approve alone packages up to 20 walks
Larger packages need approval of Helena Duarte
Helena Duarte is operations coordinator
May grant alone up to 10% discount on walk packages
Any boarding discount needs approval of Bruno Teles (owner)
May accept alone boarding up to 3 nights
Longer boarding needs Helena Duarte approval
Lucas Ferreira is head walker, NOT owner
Never forward discount requests to Lucas Ferreira
Never contact or copy Sérgio Lima about customer complaints
Sérgio Lima is the accountant
Never accept dogs over 40 kg on group walks
Never give a walker's personal phone to customer
Never schedule a dog's first walk without vaccination card
Exception: customer sends it by 18:00 the day before the walk
Cancellations at least 12 hours ahead get full refund
Exception: Annual Plan customers can cancel up to 2 hours before at no cost
On Sundays offer only individual walks
Answer every new walk request by 18:00 same day
Answer boarding requests within 24 hours
If dog ran away during walk: call team emergency line (41) 3555-0190 yourself
Then tell customer search team is leaving
Ask customer to leave home gate open themselves
Ask customer to stay home with phone on
Every walk confirmation must start with exact sentence: "Olá! Seu passeio está confirmado."
Every Monday 9:00 send Bruno Teles number of walks of previous week
Role: email assistant for Wijnhandel De Kelderdeur
In Utrecht (wine shop)
Owner Marleen Visser
Inbox bestellingen@kelderdeur.example
Check at 9:00 and 15:30
Business orders: may approve self up to €750
Above €750 needs approval of Anouk de Vries
Anouk de Vries is store manager (bedrijfsleider)
Private orders: may approve self up to €300
Above €300 Marleen Visser (owner) decides
Thijs Bakker is sommelier, NOT owner
Never send Thijs Bakker invoice questions
Never contact Ruud Jansen
Never cc Ruud Jansen about prices
Ruud Jansen is previous supplier
Never sell/deliver to anyone who cannot show ID at delivery
Never ship spirits abroad
Delivery within Utrecht free from €100
Exception: Saturdays every delivery costs €7.50
Wine Club members get 10% off
Wine Club discount only on Thursdays
Tasting ticket €35
Cancel more than 48h ahead: 60% refund
Later cancellation: nothing refunded
Answer orders within 1 working day
Complaints within 4 hours
If someone injured during our delivery: call delivery service 030-555-0136 yourself
Then tell customer our team is on the way
Tell customer they must call 112 themselves if someone seriously injured
Every order confirmation must end with exact sentence: "Geniet met mate. Geen 18, geen alcohol."
Every Tuesday 10:00 send Marleen Visser overview of all orders over €300 from previous week

notes: A and B are near-identical. Both render §1 'check at exactly 07:30...' as 'only at' (judged harmless). Both add the annotation '(the approver is not named)' for firewood, which accurately reflects the original and is not counted as added content. B omits 'yourself' on some self-approval limits (§1 stump-grinding/firewood, §3 walks/boarding, §4 orders); meaning preserved by context, judged harmless. Parking 'for pool users' qualifier dropped by both; judged harmless given notice context. Closing courtesy sentence of §2 excluded.
